856-3967-4321-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-3967-4321-8347.description:

Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.

710-5686-8207.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

4089-5011-6495.description:

When Glasspool Mimic dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Repeat.
4089-5011-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Pawn of Ulamog, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

225-851-2557-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
3738-4050-6972.notes: If Sightless Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-2511-7297.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2511-7297.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1399-1606-6984-7223.notablePrerequisites:
Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it.
You control three or more creatures.
1399-1606-6984-7223.description:
Activate Evendo, Waking Haven by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Evendo, Waking Haven.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

1659-2034-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

4772-7009-7012.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doubling Season.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

4908-5078-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

618-6473-6797.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Siegebreaker.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Mardu Siegebreaker token.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1343-2686-5067.description:
Cast Release to the Wind by paying {2}{U}, exiling Barren Glory with the ability to cast it from exile.
Cast Kaervek's Spite by paying {B}{B}{B}, discarding your hand, and sacrificing all permanents, causing target player to lose 5 life.
Cast Barren Glory from exile without paying its mana cost.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.

One of Trade Caravan or Court of Vantress has a currency counter on it.
You control a basic Island.

During your upkeep, Stasis, Trade Caravan and Court of Vantress trigger.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
Resolve the Trade Caravan and Court of Vantress triggers, putting a currency counter on each of them.
During an opponent's upkeep, activate either Trade Caravan or Court of Vantress by removing two currency counters from it, untapping a basic Island.
Repeat.

1808-2921-6291.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1432-5475--80.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
There is another legendary creature on the battlefield.
1432-5475--80.description:
If Forensic Researcher is not your Ring-bearer, use the card that causes the Ring to tempt you to cause Forensic Researcher to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher and another legendary creature.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat from step 2.

3821-5140-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}.
3821-5140-5231.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Peregrine Drake, adding {R}.
Repeat.

3484-4374-5921.notablePrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
You have at least two energy counters.
3484-4374-5921.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

1636-2438-2527-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2438-2527-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-2665--39.notablePrerequisites: Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-2665--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Progenitor Mimic trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

168-526-1270-5193.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
168-526-1270-5193.description:
Cast Anikthea from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring from your graveyard and creating three token copies of it that are 3/3 Zombies.
When the Oblivion Ring tokens enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Anikthea until the Oblivion Ring token leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the second Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling the first Oblivion Ring token.
When the first Oblivion Ring token is exiled, Anikthea returns to the battlefield from exile.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, choosing not to exile anything.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating three token copies of the Oblivion Ring token.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kozilek's Predator, adding {C}{C}.
When Kozilek's Predator dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Kozilek's Predator from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Kozilek's Predator enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
